title: The Waif
scope: The accident, the crossings and their outcomes
premise: A car crash kills Ben's son. Ben finds a revolver, and each time he uses it on himself he wakes in a world where the crash went differently. What is actually happening to him?
ending: Ben ends up with his family alive, having never undone the crash. The worlds he wakes in all separated from the same accident and were running without him; the morning the film closes on belongs to none of them.

people.name: Ben
people.introduction: The man the film follows. He carries no memory from one world into the next.

people.name: The Waif
people.introduction: The woman who falls onto the car. She is the one person who remembers between worlds.

events.title: The falling-car accident splits the outcomes
events.text: A woman falls from an office window onto the roof of the family car. The accident has more than one outcome, and the ones that follow all separate here.

events.title: The fall kills the Waif and Jack
events.text: The outcome the film opens in. The woman dies on the roof of the car and Jack is killed beside his father.

events.title: The Waif survives the fall
events.text: A second outcome of the same accident. The falling woman is not killed, and this world carries on with her alive in it.

events.title: Jack lives; this world already lost Ben
events.text: A third outcome of the same accident. Jack survives it and the Ben of that world does not. It has been running ever since.

events.title: Grief, the cabin, the book and the gun
events.text: Ben's life after the crash. At the cabin he finds a book that explains how this works, and a revolver hidden in the crawlspace.

events.title: Ben pulls the trigger
events.text: Ben turns the revolver on himself. He does not undo the crash and he does not stay: he leaves this world.

events.title: He comes round in the world where she lived
events.text: He wakes in the outcome where the falling woman survived. It has been running since the accident, and the woman here is not the one who died on his car.

events.title: The living Waif arrives at the cabin
events.text: She comes to the door. She knows him, and she remembers what he cannot.

events.title: She describes the surviving branches
events.text: She explains what happens each time: an outcome where the shot is fatal, and an outcome that carries on.

events.title: His next pull takes him on again
events.text: He uses the revolver a second time and leaves this world too.

events.title: The followed Ben enters that existing history
events.text: He wakes in the outcome where Jack survived the accident and its own Ben died. That history did not begin when he arrived in it.

events.title: Her account leaves things out
events.text: What she has told him about the padded room turns out to be partial.

events.title: Ben tries again after the failed reunion
events.text: The reunion does not hold. He returns to the cabin and fires a third time. This pull separates an outcome that ends here.

events.title: A fatal outcome is shown
events.text: The outcome of that pull in which the shot kills him. This is where that perspective ends.

events.title: The film resumes with a surviving Ben
events.text: He wakes again, in a history that was already under way, and this time his family are alive in it.

events.title: The robbery and the planted gun are revealed
events.text: The backstory behind the revolver comes out.

events.title: The family dies in the pickup
events.text: The house is attacked. Marie and Jack are killed.

events.title: She disables the special chamber
events.text: The Waif puts the revolver's last chamber beyond use.

events.title: The jumper was the Waif
events.text: The woman who fell onto the car at the start was her.

events.title: Ben's final shot
events.text: He uses the revolver for the last time.

events.title: The Others take her
events.text: The pale figures take the woman apart at the end of the pass.

events.title: Meanwhile, an independent parallel family
events.text: A morning that runs alongside the opening: the family are together, the boy steps on the toy car, the light stays red and he draws on the glass. Nothing causally connects this universe to Ben's journey, and it is not the result of his final shot.

chapters.title: One accident, several outcomes
chapters.introduction: The crash does not have a single result. Three outcomes separate from it, and all three keep running whether or not the film shows them.

chapters.title: The first crossing
chapters.introduction: The revolver does not rewind anything. It takes him out of one outcome and into another that has been running since the accident.

chapters.title: The second crossing
chapters.introduction: He arrives in the outcome where his son survived the crash and he himself did not.

chapters.title: The last pull, and what he keeps
chapters.introduction: The third pull is the one that visibly separates a fatal outcome, and it carries him into the history where his family are alive.

chapters.title: The morning that belongs to no one
chapters.introduction: The film closes on a universe that runs alongside the opening and never touches Ben's journey.

sources.title: Repository story record
sources.note: Adapted from the author-corrected encoding. Wording and interpretation await review against the primary work.

flowchart.title: The accident, the crossings and their outcomes
flowchart.description: One accident separates into three outcomes. Ben crosses between them; his arrival never begins the history he arrives in. The closing morning is a separate universe with no connection to any of it.
flowchart.frame: Read downwards. An outcome begins at the accident that separates it and keeps running afterwards, shown or not. Dashed arrows move a person; they never create the place they arrive at.

timelines.description: The outcome the film opens in.

timelines.label: The Waif survives
timelines.description: Separates at the accident. Ben enters it at his first pull, long after it began.

timelines.label: Jack lives; Ben died

timelines.label: The shot is fatal
timelines.description: The outcome separated by the third pull, where it kills him.

timelines.description: Already under way when he arrives at scene 185.

timelines.label: An independent parallel universe
timelines.description: Runs alongside the opening. Nothing connects it to Ben's journey.

The accident separates an outcome in which Jack survives and Ben is killed.

Ben leaves the opening outcome and wakes where she survived. That world has run since the accident; he did not begin it.
